column1: # Weights for scripts/ci/testshards -weights on the UNIT legs (test-unit): import-path<TAB>seconds.
# Rows are `ok`-line durations (s) WITHOUT -race (CGO_ENABLED=0), from test-unit of
# merge_group run 44559477253 (2026-11-19), which ran every package in ONE job
# (unsharded) on a slow runner — relative weights, not walls; refresh when the
# mix drifts. Packages under 10 s are left out: unlisted packages weigh 1, so a
# stale or missing row only degrades the balance — it never errors. The -race
# legs keep their own table (test-shards-weights.tsv): the detector (with cgo)
# and the co-packing reorder the costs (the unit reading ran unsharded). e2e
# #3758 moved the whole-tree sweeps of bots, pkg/server, pkg/runtime, pkg/cli and
# pkg/backend/model into internal/sweep/*. Their rows, and the seconds taken off
# their source packages' rows, are ESTIMATES until the next CI refresh:
# - internal/sweep/authorcorpus: 64 s, the moved tests' CI duration in #3758's
# - internal/sweep/authorreading: 38 s, the seconds its tests took inside pkg/server in
# - every other internal/sweep row is a local `ok`-line duration in this build mode
#   (CGO_ENABLED=0, -count=1, one run per package on a loaded workstation):
#   runtimecatalog 42, runtimeseams 18 and e2ematrix 20 read on 2026-11-26. The
#   same pass found these under 10 s and so left them out: mintchokepoint 5,
#   catalogclaims 3, modelseams 1, itertoken 1, and serversurface, sandboximages,
# - catalogcorpus and publishedtree are left out too: their loaded-workstation
#   readings (33 s, 24 s) measured the load, not the package. Each compiled test
#   binary (CGO_ENABLED=0), run ALONE from its own package directory with
#   -test.count=1 on 2026-11-27 (#3758's review round), took 6.9 s and 4.8 s of
#   wall at GOMAXPROCS=32, 5.3 s and 4.6 s at GOMAXPROCS=4: about 7 s and 5 s,
#   under the 10 s floor. A rerun of the same binaries beside other sessions'
#   gates (load ~33 on 32 cores) took 11-15 s and 8 s.
